name: Zola Mabaso
bio:
Zola Mabaso's journey into motorsport began in her father's garage, tinkering with engines from a young age. Growing up in Johannesburg, she developed a fascination with the precision and power of racing machines. This passion led her to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, after which she honed her skills working on various automotive projects before finally landing a role with Peugeot TotalEnergies.

Zola is known for her meticulous attention to detail and her ability to diagnose and solve complex mechanical problems efficiently. Her calm and collected demeanor under pressure makes her an invaluable asset to the team, particularly during high-stakes races. She prides herself on maintaining the highest standards of performance and reliability in the machinery she works on, ensuring the team's success on the track. Her deep understanding of vehicle dynamics and her unwavering commitment to excellence make her a distinctive and respected member of the Peugeot TotalEnergies crew.

physical.description: Zola is of average height with a strong, athletic build.

quirks: Always sharpens her tools before and after each use.
Has a specific playlist of South African house music she listens to while working.
Keeps a small succulent plant on her workbench for good luck.
